{{Top|leg}}
'''Croy''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Croy commentated on the entry for the [[Hound-W2 SPD]], noting that the droid's ability to locate covert communications and hidden weapons made it the bane of [[Fringer/Legends|fringers]] across the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
